co2._notes: CO2 (mg/L) = HCO3 (mg/L) x 10^(pK - pH). No temperature dependence.

concentrateTds._notes: Vontron computes TDS_conc = (adjusted feed TDS rounded to 2 decimals) x CF. Inferred from golden 10.5: 979.92 x 4 = 3919.68 (unrounded 979.922 x 4 = 3919.69).

sdsi._notes: K = c0 + c1*I + c2*I^2 + cT*(T - 25). CONFIRMED for I = 0.02-0.13. PROVISIONAL / TODO-CONFIRM for I > 0.13 (seawater).

lsi._notes: pHs = base + A + B - C - D. lsiMode 'standard' = behaviour B. PROVISIONAL / TODO-CONFIRM: behaviour A and the temperature effect.

ksp._notes: Ksp(I,T) = K * I^n * exp(E*(1/refTempK - 1/(T+273.15))). PROVISIONAL / TODO-CONFIRM general form (confirmed for TC-Water A only).
ksp._replicateVontronSrSO4Jump: PROVISIONAL / TODO-CONFIRM: awaiting client decision. When false, the low-TDS SrSO4 constants are always used.

warnings.textTemplate: {X} Saturation limits  exceeded ,Antiscalants may be required or change your system design.
warnings._lsiThreshold: PROVISIONAL / TODO-CONFIRM: the CaCO3 warning is shown when concentrate LSI > this value.

antiscalantLimits._notes: PROVISIONAL / TODO-CONFIRM: limits used when 'Dosing Antiscalants' is selected. Default = the same as without antiscalant.

phAdjust._notes: PROVISIONAL / TODO-CONFIRM: no Vontron data yet. Total carbonate is conserved; HCO3/CO2 = 10^(pH - pK) on a molar basis.

trafficLight._notes: Dashboard: green < amberFraction x limit, amber up to the limit, red above.
trafficLight._lsiAmberBand: PROVISIONAL / TODO-CONFIRM: LSI is a difference, not a %, so it is amber when within this band below the CaCO3 threshold.
